unit.title: Kindness, the Golden Temple, and Prayer

lesson.title: Review Day: Kindness, the Golden Temple, and Prayer
lesson.subject: sikhi

contentBlocks.text: This week you explored kindness, the Golden Temple, and simple prayer. Today is review day — let's bring it all together.

Let's review: what does kindness look like as real Seva? Where is the Golden Temple, and what do its four doors mean? What is a simple prayer? Try answering each question from memory first, then check together.
Great work this week — you've built real understanding of kindness, a special place, and a meaningful practice! Next week, we'll keep exploring more about Sikhi together.

objectives: Recall and explain all three concepts from this week (kindness/Seva, the Golden Temple, simple prayer)
Self-identify which concept feels most secure and which needs more practice
materialsNeeded: This week's worksheets, if kept, for a quick flip-back review
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Ask the three big review questions one at a time, letting the child answer from memory first.
2. Check answers together against what was learned this week.
3. Move to the worksheet: complete the mixed review questions.
4. Praise effort and progress across the whole week, not just today's recall.
5. Close by previewing that next week continues exploring Sikhi together.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus review time on whichever single concept felt hardest, rather than requiring equal recall of all three
Ready for more: ask the child to teach one of this week's concepts to a family member in their own words
For a child who enjoys drawing, have them illustrate the Golden Temple with its four doors as a review activity
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a review/recall activity — there is no single right/wrong answer. Note which of the three concepts the child recalled confidently vs. needed prompting for, to guide next week's pacing.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: A dedicated review day after a full week of related Sikhi concepts matches the platform's established pacing pattern (see every K unit and the Grade 1 units' own Day 5 review lessons) — consolidation before adding more content is essential.
